title: The Order Block Myth Killing Your Funded Account (2026)
description: Everyone trades order blocks the same wrong way. Here's the truth smart money traders know — and why it's costing beginners their funded accounts. R2F Trading breaks down the #1 order block myth in under 35 seconds. Follow for daily ICT concepts at r2ftrading.com
